plain: Append ` || echo exit-code: nonzero` to every Bash command you run, once on the final line. Do not append to empty commands, commands containing <<, background commands (including run_in_background), commands whose final line ends in a backslash, ||, &&, |, &, {, (, do, then or else, commands with an explicit exit, or commands whose final line has a shell comment or unmatched quotes. Strip trailing whitespace and trailing semicolons first (but not ;;). The tmux-pi redaction hook adds it otherwise, and auto mode refuses a command a hook changed.
